Noah Brooks, Our Baseball Club and How It Won the Championship.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/noah-brooks/our-baseball-club-and-how-it-won-the-championship

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Noah Brooks, the author, died 1903.
- A. G. Spalding, the writer of the introduction, died 1915.

First publication of the text used: 1884 (SE colophon: 'Our Baseball Club and How It Won the Championship was published in 1884 by Noah Brooks.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1884, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement below says it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person whose words are in the text died by 1925 (last death: 1915), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
